 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Kansas City Chiefs have extended their lead over the Atlanta Falcons as the first half of their Week 10 matchup winds down.
 After a quick score on their first drive, the Chiefs' offense plateaued for most of the first two quarters until quarterback Patrick Mahomes put on a vintage performance on the final drive of the second quarter.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Mahomes led the offense downfield before finding newly acquired wide receiver Josh Downs for an acrobatic end-zone catch to put Kansas City up by 14.
 Take a look at this video of Downs' dazzling touchdown catch, which was posted to Twitter by the Chiefs' official account:
 Kansas City acquired Downs at the tail end of this year's trade deadline, and the former third-round pick has put on an impressive performance in his first game as a Chief.
 Downs' success will be crucial if Kansas City wants to maintain its winning ways and reach another Super Bowl.
